invariants.statement: declaring a bridge cannot increase source_authority or evidence_entitlement
changing geometry coordinates alone cannot increase evidence_entitlement
an unresolved material jurisdiction or unresolved current clinical-guidance source cannot produce MODE_OK for a binding legal rule or normative clinical-guidance claim
uncontrolled co-primary conflict cannot be transformed into a single stronger claim by conflict resolution

nonclaims: These witnesses establish only internal consistency properties of a finite policy model.
They do not establish that any external law, clinical recommendation, physical theory, or empirical result is correct.
A future Lean 4 formalization may strengthen machine checking without changing this boundary.
